scripts.text:
^FF0000[ Treasure Hunter Guild House ]^000000
 
Welcome to the Treasure Hunter's Guild House.
Feel free to drop in and look around
and feel free to become a member if you wish.
 
For membership applications please talk to Keegan
up the stairs and down the hall.
scripts.translation:
^FF0000[ 寻宝猎人公会会馆 ]^000000

欢迎来到寻宝猎人公会会馆。
请随意参观，有兴趣的话也可以加入公会。

想申请入会，请上楼沿走廊找基根。

scripts.text:
[Ahlma]
Welcome to The Treasure Hunter Guild.
How may I help you?
scripts.translation:
[阿尔玛]
欢迎来到寻宝猎人公会。
有什么可以帮你的吗？

scripts.text:
[Ahlma]
Ok, saved. Thank you ~ See you soon~
scripts.translation:
[阿尔玛]
好，存档点已记录。
谢谢~ 下次见~

scripts.text:
[Ahlma]
Well if you think you are safe, good on you.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔玛]
既然你觉得安全，那就祝你好运吧。

scripts.text:
[Smile Gal]
Oh man...I am so sick of
trading Mr. Smile masks for crap.
 
You ask me for one and you'll find yourself 10 pounds lighter!
scripts.translation:
[微笑女孩]
天哪... 我真是受够了拿笑脸面具换那些破烂。

敢找我要面具，保证让你轻上十磅！

scripts.text:
[Sharlet]
Umm sorry I'm not gonna waste my time talking to you if you aren't even a member!
scripts.translation:
[夏莱特]
嗯，抱歉，如果你连会员都不是，我可没空跟你废话！

scripts.text:
How are you reading this???
Well unless you are reading the code :)
scripts.translation:
你怎么能读到这段话？？？
除非你是在看代码 :)

scripts.text:
Ahh welcome fellow Treasure Hunter {0}.
Did you hear about that brave man that went into Glast Heim alone?! He must be crazy.
scripts.translation:
啊，欢迎，寻宝猎人 {0}。
听说有人独自闯进了格拉斯特海姆吗？！
他肯定疯了。

scripts.text: {0} don't you have something better you could be doing? Like a quest.
scripts.translation: {0}，你难道没有更该做的事吗？比如去做个任务。

scripts.text:
[Sasha]
Umm sorry I'm not gonna waste my time talking to you if you aren't even a member!
scripts.translation:
[萨莎]
嗯，抱歉，如果你连会员都不是，我可没空跟你废话！

scripts.text:
Ahh welcome fellow Treasure Hunter {0}.
Did you hear about that goat man running around in the trees?
 
Apparently his name is Baphomet and he has been running around the Forest Maze out side of Prontera for quite some time now.
scripts.translation:
啊，欢迎，寻宝猎人 {0}。
听说过那个在树林里四处乱跑的山羊人吗？

据说他叫巴风特，已经在普隆德拉城外的迷藏森林里游荡很久了。

scripts.text: {0} don't you have something better you could be doing? Like a quest.
scripts.translation: {0}，你难道没有更该做的事吗？比如去做个任务。
